source_text: Constituite urbes fugitivorum — innocens qui non volens occidit. Christus refugium animae; via usque ad sacerdotis mortem — usque ad Christi passionem.
pass_a_gloss: Establish cities of-fugitives — innocent who not willing killed. Christ refuge of-soul; way until unto of-priest death — until unto of-Christ passion.
pass_b_english: [[Appoint cities of refuge for the one who kills without intent >> Bible:Joshua 20:1-6]]. Christ is the soul’s refuge; the road runs until the high priest’s death — until Christ’s passion.
